newsitem.title: USA: Indiana United sees '97 EPS topping '96.
newsitem.headline: Indiana United sees '97 EPS topping '96.

text.p: Indiana United Bancorp said on Tuesday that fourth quarter earnings per share look favorable and results for 1997 are likely to greatly exceed those of 1996.
"Fourth-quarter 1996 earnings look favorable and fiscal 1997 is now expected to generate earnings per share greatly exceeding 1996 levels," said chairman Robert Hoptry in a statement.

Earlier, the company reported third-quarter earnings of $317,589, or $0.25 per share. It said net income of its Regional Bank and Indiana United was reduced by a charge of $474,178 in the period due to structural changes in the banking and thrift industries.
Hoptry said the charge was in line with company expectations.
